cat > /workspace/tmp/source_tests.py <<'PY'
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');import gateway
D={'sip:alice@local.test':['sip:a@alias.test','tel:+1555'],'sip:bob@other.test':['tel:+1999'],'sip:carol@local.test':[]}
B={'directory':D,'accounts':{'alice':{'primary':'sip:alice@local.test','allow':['sip:carol@local.test']},'carol':{'primary':'sip:carol@local.test','allow':[]}},'gateways':{'g':{'local_domains':['local.test'],'peers':{'p':['other.test','local.test']}}},'jobs':[]}
def raw(frm='<sip:alice@local.test>',extra=(),body=''):
 h=['MESSAGE sip:d@d SIP/2.0','From: '+frm,'To: <sip:d@d>','Call-ID: x','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE']+list(extra)+['Content-Length: '+str(len(body))]
 return '\r\n'.join(h)+'\r\n\r\n'+body
def run(jobs):
 b=dict(B);b['jobs']=jobs;return gateway.process(b)['results']
# private, trusted false -> peer source unauthenticated
r=run([{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'alice'},'trusted_out':False,'raw':raw(extra=['Privacy: id'])},
       {'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'peer','name':'p'},'trusted_out':True,'source':0},
       {'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'carol'},'trusted_out':True,'source':0}])
for i,x in enumerate(r): print(i,x['status'],x.get('reason'),x.get('identity'),x.get('private'))
print('wire0',r[0]['wire'])
# private trusted true -> peer p accepts alice (p authority supports local.test)
r=run([{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'alice'},'trusted_out':True,'raw':raw(extra=['Privacy: id'])},
       {'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'peer','name':'p'},'trusted_out':False,'source':0}])
for i,x in enumerate(r): print(i,x['status'],x.get('reason'),x.get('identity'),x.get('private'),x.get('wire'))
# nonprivate at local source to local carol: alice not allowed -> identity; source to alice works
r=run([{'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'alice'},'trusted_out':False,'raw':raw()},
       {'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'carol'},'trusted_out':True,'source':0},
       {'gateway':'g','ingress':{'kind':'local','subject':'alice'},'trusted_out':True,'source':0}])
for i,x in enumerate(r): print(i,x['status'],x.get('reason'),x.get('identity'))
PY
cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/tmp python3 tmp/source_tests.py
